_what: notebook folders for the try page's machine-log check, and what notebook.py verify said about each
_produced_by: scripts/make_machine_log_fixture.py: tools/machine-notebook/notebook.py and tet-cli agent sign/verify
_device_key: not included; each device phrase was discarded with its temp folder

cases.name: valid
cases.why: four records, record 2 cites a permit once

verify.stdout:
VALID
  4 records, all signed by tet-ed25519:d2175b2342bb456da1fdffe9dc35e4682b6273df8df07b178c4f1748cfd70ac0
  permit 6b9aeddf19082227418854396eb7688f (open-valve): used once, by record 2; open until seq 3
Shows:
  - which key signed each record
  - that the records are in this order
  - that each record was written before the next one
  - that no one-time permission was used twice in this log, or after it ran out
Does not show:
  - that the reading is true
  - that the machine's clock was right
  - where the machine was
  - who runs the machine
  - that the key was not copied
  - that a copied key did not use the same permission in another log
stamp: not checked (no node)
